thread:
Tessa: Quick design note from today's review: the in-console help card and the docs disagree on terminology. Console uses "canary rollout" while the docs page is titled "Canary deployment" (anchor #canary-deploy). Users clicking "See docs" end up at the top of the guide. Small but confusing.

Ravi: Thanks. We should pick one canonical phrase. The SDK and telemetry use "canary_rollout" though, so maybe normalize docs and UI to "canary rollout" instead of changing many backend names.

Marta: UX constraint: the card header is tight; "Canary rollout" fits, but the help link text "See docs" is ambiguous. For accessibility, let's make link text explicit and include a visually-hidden note: "Canary rollout guide, opens in new tab".

Eli: Dev notes: the console currently links to /docs/releases/canary (no hash), and our docs SPA sometimes strips hashes on mount. Plan: 1) update console to link to full URL with hash: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases#canary-deploy; 2) add target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer and aria-label from DS token.

a11y-bot: Accessibility reminder: after opening the docs anchor, the docs site must move focus to the anchor element (set tabindex=-1 then focus) to provide context for screen reader users. Also ensure opening in a new tab is announced: aria-label should include "opens in new tab".

Tessa: Design decision: we'll adopt "Canary rollout" as the canonical term in the UI and add an alias H2 in docs with id="canary-rollout" that links to #canary-deploy and includes a short note about the naming history to avoid breaking bookmarks.

Ravi: Implementation checklist:
- Console: change link to absolute URL + hash, set target/_blank + rel, pass aria-label token (ETA 2d).
- Docs: add alias H2 id="canary-rollout" that anchors to #canary-deploy and update router to preserve hash + focus (ETA 1d).
- Design: update token label.short.release = "Rollout" and label.long.release = "Canary rollout" (ETA 1d).

Marta: I'll update Figma tokens and the help card component to accept an externalAccessibilityLabel prop and visually-hidden text for screen readers.

Eli: I'll submit the frontend PR with the link change and a small e2e keyboard test that opens the help card, tabs to link, activates it, and asserts focus moves to the docs anchor (ETA 3d).

docs-bot: Created task #5899: "Harmonize 'Canary rollout' vs 'Canary deployment' across console and docs; add alias anchor and a11y focus handling" assigned to Eli, Marta, Ravi.

Tessa: Thanks all. After merges let's pair-run VoiceOver/NVDA checks together. :thumbsup:
